evidence: Surname-only widow Roemond has 16 adult enslaved men and 2 women, matching the 1713 return of Michiel Romont and Cornelis [Cornelia] van den Bogart (hhobs6050). The 1712 older Michiel and Cornelia are hhobs5688. No widow given name is supplied; resource continuity supports but does not prove identity. Alternative to hhobs5691, never an additional assignment to the same widow.

Another baseline man has the same surname and given name, with de jonge qualifier and no wife or adult slaves recorded. A blank wife field does not prove he was unmarried. Retained as the conservative alternative identity for surname-only widow6350; cannot be combined with assignment to hhobs5688. Gerrit Romond5689 is a living declarant in MOOC8/2.111 and continues in later rolls, so is not assigned this widow.
